card.name: Linking words before opioid drug names
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as 'taking', 'as', 'of', 'using' or 'Use' that sit just before a named drug in opioid label warnings. The drug name (opioid product, naloxone, bupropion) comes next.

modes.label: Patient taking a drug
modes.description: The word 'taking' or 'using' after 'patient' or 'women', right before an opioid product name.
modes.example: discontinue therapy in an opioid-dependent patient<< taking>> BELBUCA, there are a variety

modes.label: Such as before an example drug
modes.description: The word 'as' in 'such as' introducing naloxone or nalmefene as reversal agents.
modes.example: Advise patients and caregivers that opioid overdose reversal agents, such<< as>> naloxone or nalmefene

card.writes: It seems to prepare the model for a drug name to come next, though the promoted tokens are unrelated.
card.plain: It marks the small word right before a specific drug name in opioid warnings, such as 'taking' or 'such as'.
